title: Pre-revenue Startups and Founder Quality
primary_theme: Pre-Seed Capital as Product-Market Fit Finding, Not Company Building
founder_lessons: Explain what the product does, why it matters, and for whom before asking investors to engage deeply.
Raise an amount appropriate to the proof points needed for product-market fit.
Treat bridge funding as a bridge to specific evidence, not as a way to avoid clarity.
Use investor updates and early relationships to let insiders understand what is not yet public about the company.
notable_quotes: the million-dollar pre-seed round is not for company building as much as it is for product-market fit finding.
get really, really clear on what your product does and why it matters. And to whom it matters.
There's something to be said about giving people the ability to demonstrate selection skill earlier in their lives.
